ideas.title: Two-sided calibrated benefit estimate (direct confidence + per-query tool success)
ideas.problem_slice: Black-box rules calibrate p_direct but treat p_tool as a global constant.
ideas.method: p_direct_hat: isotonic-calibrated combination of verbalized confidence and k-sample answer agreement. p_tool_hat: small classifier on query text features (embedding from a frozen small encoder) trained on logged tool-run outcomes. Delta_hat = p_tool_hat - p_direct_hat; call iff Delta_hat > lambda*c + sampling cost.
ideas.experiment: Anchor's three scenarios (reduced); baselines: CTA rule with global p_ret, calibrated direct-confidence threshold, anchor explicit modelling (reduced reproduction), always/never. Metric: U-AUC, ECE of Delta_hat.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Per-query p_tool_hat improves U-AUC over a global p_ret rule.

ideas.title: Tool-preview signals: estimate tool benefit from a cheap partial call
ideas.problem_slice: p_tool cannot be known before calling; a cheap preview (e.g. retriever top-k scores, calculator parse success) may reveal it.
ideas.method: Before the full call, run a low-cost preview (BM25 top-k scores and title overlap; expression parse/size for the calculator; problem-type classifier for the reasoner). Features feed p_tool_hat. Preview cost is charged in U.
ideas.experiment: Ablate with/without preview; report net U after preview cost.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Preview features raise p_tool AUROC enough to pay for their cost on retrieval.

ideas.title: Adaptive-sample consistency (SPRT-style) to cut signal cost
ideas.problem_slice: Consistency signals need k samples per query; fixed k wastes calls on easy queries.
ideas.method: Draw samples one at a time; stop when the posterior over agreement makes the call/no-call decision unambiguous at the current lambda (sequential probability ratio test).
ideas.experiment: Mean samples per query, U net of sampling cost vs fixed k in {1,3,5,10}.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: SPRT reaches fixed-k=10 U-AUC using < 4 samples on average.

ideas.title: Proxy white-box probe predicting a black-box model's tool benefit
ideas.problem_slice: Black-box models expose no internals, but a small open proxy's hidden states may predict where the big model needs tools.
ideas.method: Train a When2Tool-style probe on a small open model's hidden states, with labels from the black-box target's NoTool/AlwaysTool outcomes.
ideas.experiment: Target = larger open model used as black box; proxy = 1.7B-4B; AUROC and U-AUC.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Proxy probe predicts target need above query-text baselines.

ideas.title: Why does absolute estimation beat consistency? A diagnostic across query types
ideas.problem_slice: The anchor reports absolute > consistency estimation without diagnosis (G15).
ideas.method: Stratify by query type and difficulty; measure calibration and confidently-wrong rate of consistency vs absolute labels; test hybrid estimator.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Consistency fails mainly on confidently-wrong queries.

ideas.title: Conformal tool calling with a guaranteed accuracy floor
ideas.problem_slice: No black-box method guarantees bounded accuracy loss from skipped calls.
ideas.method: Calibrate the skip threshold on a held-out set so that, with probability 1-delta, accuracy loss vs always-call <= epsilon; minimise calls subject to it.
ideas.experiment: Empirical coverage and calls saved at epsilon in {1,2,5}%.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Guarantee holds empirically with substantial call savings.

ideas.title: Few-shot recalibration of black-box confidence under domain shift
ideas.problem_slice: Isotonic maps fitted in-domain miscalibrate under shift (G12).
ideas.method: Fit calibration on source; recalibrate with 50-200 labelled target examples; compare isotonic, temperature-like Platt, and hierarchical pooling.
ideas.experiment: Train on TriviaQA, test on PopQA/NQ; ECE and U.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: 50-shot recalibration recovers most of in-domain U.

ideas.title: Query-only utility router (zero extra model calls)
ideas.problem_slice: All sampling-based signals cost calls; a router on query text costs nothing.
ideas.method: Small encoder classifier predicts sign(Delta(x) - lambda*c) from query text with lambda as input.
ideas.experiment: U-AUC vs sampling-based estimators at zero signal cost.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Router is competitive when signal costs are high.

ideas.title: Ask the model for two numbers: chance of being right alone, chance the tool helps
ideas.problem_slice: Verbalized confidence covers only the direct side.
ideas.method: Prompt for p_direct and p_tool separately; calibrate each by isotonic regression; decide with lambda*c.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Verbalized p_tool adds information after calibration.

ideas.title: Contextual-bandit estimation of tool benefit during deployment
ideas.problem_slice: Labelled calibration data may be unavailable; benefit can be learned online.
ideas.method: Linear contextual bandit over query features; arm = call/no-call; reward = correct - lambda*c.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Bandit reaches offline rule within a few hundred queries.

ideas.title: Post-call reliability check: trust or re-call
ideas.problem_slice: Tools can return wrong or noisy outputs; decision after the call is unmodelled.
ideas.method: Classify tool output reliability from output features; decide accept/re-call/answer directly.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Reliability check reduces errors from noisy tools at small cost.

ideas.title: Cross-model disagreement as a black-box benefit signal
ideas.problem_slice: Self-consistency can be confidently wrong; disagreement with a second cheap model may expose it.
ideas.method: Compare the target's answer with a cheap second model; disagreement raises p_tool estimate.
ideas.experiment: AUROC and U with and without second model; charge its cost.
ideas.hypothesis_sketch: Disagreement improves detection of confidently-wrong cases.
